We start by using the power of product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{({x}^{2}y)}^{3}\cdot {x}^{2}y= &  \\ {({x}^{2})}^{3}\cdot {y}^{3}\cdot {x}^{2}y & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we use the power rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2\cdot 3}\cdot {y}^{3}\cdot {x}^{2}y & = \\ {x}^{6}\cdot {y}^{3}\cdot {x}^{2}y & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we use the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{6}\cdot {y}^{3}\cdot {x}^{2}y= &  \\ {x}^{6}\cdot {x}^{2}\cdot {y}^{3}\cdot y= &  \\ {x}^{6+2}\cdot {y}^{3+1} & = \\ {x}^{8}\cdot {y}^{4} & = \\ {x}^{8}{y}^{4} & \end{aligned}
$$
